nodes.title: ENTER - Corridor
nodes.text:
You make your way carefully into the dungeon corridor. Damp glistens on the walls, and the air is thick with dust. Feeling your way forward, your eyes slowly begin to adjust to the darkness.

“What have I forgotten to pack?” you ask yourself.

Oh well. Too late now.

You continue for perhaps half a mile without a single junction. The corridor gradually widens, opening into cavernous spaces in places, and you begin to realise that you are slowly but surely descending deeper underground.

You stop to rest.

The darkness around you has become thick and oppressive. You pull out a small flint lantern and strike it. A tiny flame catches on the oil-soaked mantle, casting a weak pool of light around you. You must thank that halfling you met in the Wasted Wizard; if you ever see him again, he parted with this lantern for a hot meal.

It isn’t much, but it is enough to see the tips of your boots and a short distance ahead.

You continue and begin to feel tired; the air is becoming shallow and hard to breath, suddley the corridr open into a junction; some cooler air blows over you like a breath, as though the dungeon itself is breathing! You stop and try not to worry.

As you take you next step you hear a runmble, out of instinct you throw yourself on the ground just in time to feel the ground shake and pieces of rock cover you from behind... 

Lights out!

Turn to 100

nodes.title: Door - Listen first
nodes.text:
You listen at the door and can hear voices behind. Sound like some goblins eating and auduing over their food!

"Give me that bone! you had your share! says one, " get your own you greedy oaf" cries another.

You figure if you let them argue it out maybe the'll be one or two less to gight should you wish to enter.

Do you wait? Go to 25
Or burst in? Go to 374
Or return to the Junction? Go to 100

nodes.title: Stairs
nodes.text:
You climb for a long time up stone carved steps, maybe this was a real structure back in the dar as the steps are solid and well made, cold air rises from the darkness below.

You reach the top 

go to 62

nodes.title: Store Room
nodes.text: Only accessible if you have the Iron Key.

nodes.title: Troll Bridge
nodes.text:
It's hard to see into the darkness, but just ahead you see what looks like  a deep ravine and a bridge; heading over to the darkness.

You strike up your flint lantern again aware that this will soon run out if you donlt find some oil soon, as you do the cavern widens in your view casting deep shadows deep shadows but you can clearly see a route across the bridge.

The bridge has old wooden wooden planks.

You may roll on your Intelligence.

if you make that roll, go to 327
Begin to walk across the bridge 180
Go back down the stairs to the Junction 100

nodes.title: Troll Den
nodes.text:
You hop, skip and jump across the bridge trap and make it safely to the other side.
Before you is an entrance to a cave.

You peer into the dark cave and walk slowly in (something smells foul for sure); the cave slowly becomes wide and forks off into 2 directions. Bones litter the floor, and there is the smell of something boiling down the right tunnel.

nodes.title: Introduction
nodes.text:
The Ghost Bell

Throughout time, or as long as most can remember, the bells of Dragon Reach have always been a guiding light to the people of this land, not just to a call to the people on religious days and holidays, but also an early warning of invasion and danger. Some 300 bells are situated in Dragon Reach, and the communities value them all. So much so that the councils of each city and town carefully select trusted bell wardens to look afer and monitor these powerful and ancient bells; if you are awarded the rank of bell warden, you carry a lot of respect from the people of your area and are often the older and respected individuals. Tarak the healer is one of those chosen wardens, and he is proud and honoured to be so.

On this particular day, Tarak wakes unusually with an uneven feeling in his bones; something is bothering him, and he feels edgy for some reason. But as usual, he gets up and goes about his usual duties (he's a man of routine). Tarak is one of the healers situated near the city of sisters, situated in the northeast area of Dragon Reach. He looks after not just the people in his ward but is sometimes called into the city for duties to the emeseries that live and run the city there. In his spare time, when he's not being called upon as a healer, he visits the bell he is assigned to; this sits in a tower nearby, southeast of Doomsbury Hollow, near the old mage towers were he restores, repairs, and keeps them oiled and mechanically sound.

On this spring morning, Tarak is preparing his bags and satchels with herbs and potions to make his visits. He's first to visit the town square where local people are often already waiting for him to ride in. First he must organise his potions.

He heads to the back room of his small but cosy house situated on the river bank, and as he walks into the back room hidden by a false bookcase, he pulls one of the books and there is a click, it then opens up into the room where he makes his magic happen, he always gets a rush of excitment on entering the room as he feels safe and at home here of ten soending way too many hours mixing and making recipes, he scans the heavily laden shelves he has built up over the years and is proud of his collection. Shelves and shelves of bottles, boxes, leather bags and crucibles line the walls, and to the untrained eye this may seem rather disorganised, but Tarak knows what and where everything is. 

Some items in Tarak's collection may seem useless to a visitor; that's good, just a lot of powders and pots, and there's a reason for that. You or I would have no idea what they all do; they are not labelled, and no notes on the contents are written down, unlike those wizards up at the mage towers; they write everything in a book! Probably because they would forget their spells after 3 nights on the ale!

A healer would never make up a potion, label it and put it on the shelf for later use. With all the talk and gossip around the Dargonmarch taverns, what if the Shadow Army did invade and they got their hands on his potions? That could be catastrophic. No, an experienced healer would make up the potions as they need them, and his recipes would- well, they would die with him. 

Tarak has, this morning, run out of one vital herb, the herb Travelling Star, a herb needed and part of a cure for poison, and he needs them urgently. There is talk of some locals becoming very ill recently after drinking water from the local wells. He fears these may some goings on with sigtings of unkown characters hanging around the taverns, could be be spies for the oncoming attack. 

More story to add, but basically Tarak goes about his duties, realising there is poison being dumped into the rivers by a scout of the Shadow Army; he then begins his check of the bell and realises it has been shattered by a powerful spell, and 3 parts of the bell are missing. The bell cannot be used until these parts are replaced and a forging spell can make it whole again. This bell is the farthest out in the north east corner and he fears an attack is imminent.

He must warn the towns nearby but first fix the bell!

He makes up a journey potion which he sprinkles around the bell, and briefly it shows up footprints of the intruder; this leads him to a dungeon entrance hidden deep in the nearby hillside.

He enters the tunnels and begins his quest to retrieve the stolen parts of the bell.

This will be a race to find the 3 bell parts and the antidote to the poison before the shadow army attacks or the townspeople become to weak to fight.

He finds scraps of the assassin's map, now burnt and casts a restore spell, showing a rough location of the route the assassin took to get into Dragon Reach, and he makes his way to that part on the map.

Go to 2.

nodes.title: Troll rubbish shoot
nodes.text: You rummage through the piles of stinking bones and discarded previous adventures, only to find a chain mechanism. Will you pull the chain or back away?

nodes.title: Door - Open without listening
nodes.text:
You burst into what looks like a small kitchen or eating area to find 3 large goblins staring back at you.

Roll your dexterity or above to quickly slam the door and block it with a nearby latch. This is a heavy, strong door and as long as you hold that latch down, they won't get out.

If not go to #

If so, you hold the latch down for dear life! And have some time to think! The goblins smash themselves repeatedly at the door (strange because it open inwards) shouting "open this door you little weazel, we'll strip you to the bone and boil you if we  get out!!"

You may...

Smash the door lock shut, bending it with a nearby rock. This will hold until you can escape. Go to 

or prepare yourself and push fast, hopping to knock them back so you can get a drop on them?

nodes.title: Goblin - Kitchen
nodes.text:
Now all the goblins lay slain you look around. This is dirty place that would never get any reviews on Doogle (the wasted wizard notice board). There grease covered burnt pots stacked high, bones and old meat strewn across the floor and the large round table in the middle of the room seems to have a sricky sunstance.

...

nodes.title: Junction
nodes.text:
It's a while before you come round but when you you notice the way back is now blocked by a rock fall. You feel this is now a one way trip and take stock, no harm done as such but you sit for a while and rest. You eventually get to your feet, you take a short drink from you water flask and hope you can find more later and you walk a little futher to a junction.

To the right are some steps, hewn out of the rock, but clearly an ascending route to a higher ledge.

To your left is a door set back some 20 feet in the rocks.

You may...
Listen at the door 13
Open the door, turn to 374
Head up the stairs; turn to 27

nodes.title: Goblin Kitchen - Wait
nodes.text:
You are in no rush; these greedy goblins will be asleep after that meal. You wait and take a little time to meditate a little way back in the darkness, just in case they come out and time some passes.

Finally, you quietly approach the door again, you hear the voices and arguing have died down. You wait a little longer and listen, and you hear snoring.

Slowly open the door, and go in being very careful to not make any sound...

Insdie is a 2 gobins, one asleep on the table and the other laying on a straw bed with an empty bottle of what looks like oil next to him. You draw your dagger and explel the nearest one without a sound. It slumps to the floor and you catch it's fall as black blood runs over you hands.

The other you approch and as you do kick over a can of some kind of slop, roll over your dexterity or more to stop the pot spinning!

if you do you also cut the throat of this vile creature before it can even see you.

If not, it leaps to it's feet and you must fight it.

See combat

nodes.title: Bent Lock - Closes kitchen
nodes.text:
You pick up a nearby heavy rock and smash it over the latch repeatedly, bending it so it could never be opened from the inside. You hear the goblins (now realising) pulling and pushing the door to no avail; these dungeon doors are strongly made, and that's stuck fast.

You won't know how that might of turned out but you feel this could have been a nasty encounter.

You head up the stairs, this being the only way left to go.

Go to 27

nodes.title: Troll bridge int roll made
nodes.text:
You can clearly see this is a trap, the planks near the lever have hinges and are a slightly different wood to the rest.

You will need a way to pull that lever without stepping on thos planks.

You may cross the bridge anyway go #
Head back down to the junction 100

nodes.title: You make the INT roll
nodes.text:
You sit and think about that level you can see, you realise you need some rope to lasso that level and if you donlt have any maybe there's something in that door down below?

If you have the rope go to 41

You may still risk walking across the bridge go to ...
or head back down the stairs to the door 100

nodes.title: Troll bridge just cross
nodes.text:
You tread carfully along the bridge and two banks swing down, it's a trap! make a dexterity roll

If you make it go to 41
if not go to DEAD
